In Step 6, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the Danish text "Aarhus, Danmark" as "Aalborg ( lborg), Denmark". This is a hallucination where the Planner confused the city of Aarhus with the city of Aalborg (and seemingly misread the Danish text or confused the Danish city name with a different one entirely). This error led to the incorrect conclusion that the birthplace was Aalborg, contradicting the English Wikipedia page which correctly stated " rhus" (Aarhus). This mistake propagated through subsequent steps, causing the conversation to loop unnecessarily as the Planner tried to reconcile the "Aalborg" error with the " rhus" data from other sources, rather than simply accepting the correct data found in the Danish Wikipedia.
